root_cause: High-frequency context, list and count requests were causing Base44 429 rate-limit bursts.
changes: Context loading now uses session cache and single-flight dedupe.
entityListSorted now has longer cache, stronger cooldown, and returns safe empty data on 429 instead of cascading errors.
Frontend list hooks use longer per-entity throttle/cooldown.
Count hook uses longer cache and slower retry backoff.
